stories.title: El-Erian: 30-Year Treasury Yield at 5.27% Marks a Structural Shift
stories.summary: Economist Mohamed El-Erian says the 30-year Treasury yield's climb to 5.27% signals a structural shift, not a temporary spike, Yahoo Finance reports. He argues the higher long-term borrowing cost will make things more expensive across the US economy. The comment frames the move as a lasting change in the rate backdrop.
stories.whyItMatters: A structurally higher long bond yield raises borrowing costs economy-wide, from mortgages to corporate debt, and that hits stock valuations directly.
whatToWatch: Further moves in the 30-year Treasury yield
Any Fed or Treasury response to sustained high long-term rates
questions: What does El-Erian say is driving the structural shift?
